program:
app "Dry clean" box ocean
table ticket name text, phone text?, pieces num 1..40, ready date, collected bool
each ticket where collected = no sort ready as t empty "No tickets waiting"
  row card gap 2 tap edit t
    toggle t.collected
    stack grow
      t.name bold
      t.pieces "pieces" faint
    if t.ready <= today
      "Ready" color good
    else
      "in" plural(t.ready - today, "day") faint
form ticket, "New ticket"
describe:
Dry clean, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- ticket: name: text; phone: text, optional; pieces: number, 1 to 40; ready: date; collected: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each ticket where collected is no sorted by ready:
  - a group; a tap opens the ticket for editing:
    - a tick box for the collected of the ticket.
    - text: the name of the ticket.
    - text: the pieces of the ticket, "pieces".
    - if the ready of the ticket is at most today:
      - text: "Ready".
    - otherwise:
      - text: "in", the plural of the ready of the ticket minus today.
- a form to add a ticket.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Budget dial" wallet slate
table spend amount money
setting budget money = 50000 "Monthly budget"
let used = sum(spend.amount month)
let p = clamp(used / budget, 0, 1)
let ang = -90 + 180 * p
draw 100, 60 width 220
  arc 50, 55, 40, -90, 90 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 50, 55, 40, -90, ang stroke if(p > 0.85, bad, accent) thick 8
  line 50, 55, 50 + 34 * sin(ang), 55 - 34 * cos(ang) stroke ink thick 2
  circle 50, 55, 3 fill ink
used big
round(p * 100) "% of" budget faint tap edit budget
form spend
describe:
Budget dial, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- spend: amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 50000.
Works out:
- used is the total amount of spend this month.
- p is used divided by budget kept between 0 and 1.
- ang is minus 90 plus 180 times p.
Shows:
- a drawing made of arcs, lines, circles.
- text: used.
- text: p times 100 rounded, "% of", budget; a tap opens budget for editing.
- a form to add a spend.

program:
app "Exercise Pro" dumbbell ink
table lift exercise text, kg num 0.. = 0, sets num 1.. = 3, reps num 1..
let vol = sum(lift week, it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let before = sum(lift prev week, it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
row gap 2
  stat vol, "kg moved this week"
  stat round((vol - before) * 100 / before), "% vs last week"
  stat count(days week, count(lift on it) > 0), "days trained"
form lift
"Use 0 kg for bodyweight moves like push-ups." faint
button "Repeat last" tap add lift exercise = last(lift.exercise), kg = last(lift.kg), sets = last(lift.sets), reps = last(lift.reps)
"New records, last 30 days" head
each lift last 30 days sort kg desc as r
  if r.kg > 0 and r.kg = max(lift.kg where exercise = r.exercise)
    r.exercise r.kg "kg" bold
state ex text = last(lift.exercise)
field ex "Progress for"
trend lift where exercise = ex sort at, it.kg
"Best" max(lift.kg where exercise = ex) "kg" faint
daybars last 7 days, count(lift on it)
list lift by day
describe:
Exercise Pro, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- lift: exercise: text; kg: number, at least 0, starts at 0; sets: number, at least 1, starts at 3; reps: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- vol is the sum of its kg times its sets times its reps over the lift this week.
- before is the sum of its kg times its sets times its reps over the lift last week.
Remembers while you use it: ex, starting at the latest exercise of lift.
Shows:
- a big number: vol, labelled "kg moved this week".
- a big number: the result of vol minus before times 100 divided by before rounded, labelled "% vs last week".
- a big number: how many of the day this week have how many lift entries on that day is more than 0, labelled "days trained".
- a form to add a lift.
- text: "Use 0 kg for bodyweight moves like push-ups.".
- a button "Repeat last"; a tap adds a lift with exercise set to the latest exercise of lift, kg set to the latest kg of lift, sets set to the latest sets of lift, reps set to the latest reps of lift.
- text: "New records, last 30 days".
- for each lift in the last 30 days sorted by kg, highest first:
  - if the kg of the lift is more than 0 and the kg of the lift is the highest kg of lift where exercise is the exercise of the lift:
    - text: the exercise of the lift, the kg of the lift, "kg".
- a box to fill in ex, labelled "Progress for".
- a line chart of its kg over lift where exercise is ex sorted by at.
- text: "Best", the highest kg of lift where exercise is ex, "kg".
- a bar chart of how many lift entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of lift by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

program:
app "Badminton" ball slate
table point team pick Ali|Sara, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Ali)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Sara)
setting winat num = 21 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Ali" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Ali, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Sara" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Sara, pts = 1
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Ali win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Sara win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Badminton, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Ali, Sara; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 21.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Ali.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Sara.
Shows:
- text: "Ali".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Ali, pts set to 1.
- text: "Sara".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Sara, pts set to 1.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Ali win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Sara win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Medicine cabinet" pill plum
table med_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 2, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(med_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "medicines running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each med_item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(med_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form med_item
remind "Check your medicines" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Medicine cabinet, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- med item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 2; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the med item have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "medicines running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each med item where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the med item for editing; a swipe removes the med item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the med item.
    - text: the kind of the med item.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the med item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the med item to the qty of the med item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the med item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the med item to the qty of the med item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the med item.
- a form to add a med item.
Reminder "Check your medicines" at 9:00 on Sat.

fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Plant Care" plant mint
table plant name text, every num 1..60 = 3 unit "days"
table watered plant ref plant
let thirsty = count(plant, since(it.watered) >= it.every or count(it.watered) = 0)
"Need water" thirsty big color if(thirsty > 0, warn, good)
each plant sort name as p
  row card gap 1 tap edit p
    stack grow
      p.name bold
      "every" p.every "days" faint
    if since(p.watered) >= p.every or count(p.watered) = 0
      "Thirsty" color warn
    button "Watered" tap add watered plant = p
form plant, "Add plant"
heat last 70 days, count(watered on it), 3
describe:
Plant Care, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- plant: name: text; every: number, 1 to 60, in days, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- watered: plant: a plant. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- thirsty is how many of the plant have days since the last of its watered entries is at least its every or how many its watered entries is 0.
Shows:
- text: "Need water", thirsty.
- for each plant sorted by name:
  - a group; a tap opens the plant for editing:
    - text: the name of the plant.
    - text: "every", the every of the plant, "days".
    - if days since the last of the plant's watered entries is at least the every of the plant or how many the plant's watered entries is 0:
      - text: "Thirsty".
    - a button "Watered"; a tap adds a watered with plant set to the plant.
- a form to add a plant.
- a heat map of how many watered entries on that day for each day in the last 70 days.
